name: excel-skills
description: Let an AI agent edit, verify and refresh Excel workbooks without breaking them.

interface.shortDescription: Edit, verify and refresh Excel workbooks safely
interface.longDescription: Two agent skills for real Excel workbooks. excel-power-query maps every Power Query, shows which workbook feeds which, exports the M code and refreshes from the command line with proof. excel-write-verify changes values, formulas and columns inside the .xlsx file while Power Query, tables, notes and formatting stay intact, then proves the result with a cell-by-cell diff, a structural check and an independent recalculation, and replaces a shared OneDrive or SharePoint file safely.
defaultPrompt: Map the Power Query of this workbook and tell me the refresh order
Change this formula in my workbook and prove that nothing else changed
